enchantment.supplementaries.carousel.des: Quiver/lunch basket cycles to the next arrow or food in order. Not with Whimsy.
enchantment.supplementaries.stasis.desc: Slingshot shots ignore gravity; Bubble Blower bubbles become lasting blocks. Not with Multishot.
enchantment.supplementaries.whimsy.desc: Quiver/lunch basket picks the next arrow or food at random. Not with Carousel.
